evidence.reason: The download helper uses a deterministic sibling `<name>.part` and opens it with `wb`, so two invocations sharing the same state directory and downloading the same missing cache entry can truncate/interleave writes to the same file. The callers then verify and `replace()` that shared path, so one invocation can rename or verify a file the other is still writing. Using a per-invocation temporary name is a routine correctness fix; no contract clause is needed.
